pdf.method_text: Only authorized domain names and saved, supported observations are assessed: DNS email-record context, TLS certificate trust/renewal, and root HTTP/HTTPS responses and selected headers. Observation times differ from the report creation time. Failed, inconclusive and unrecorded checks remain gaps, not successful checks.
pdf.exclusions: Excluded: internal networks, malware detection, account auditing, exploitation, port sweeping, continuous monitoring and compliance certification. Current domain proof does not establish permission for every service behind a domain.

pdf.verify: Rerun this rule in a new authorized check. A completed task alone does not confirm resolution.
pdf.no_evidence: No supporting observations are available. No evidence is inferred.
pdf.evidence_note: Protocol identifiers, evidence values and source references below are preserved exactly. Empty values are not a claim of safety. References identify records inside the authenticated workspace; they grant no public access.
pdf.definitions_text: A finding is a supported configuration condition, not necessarily an exploitable vulnerability. Severity and priority come from the recorded policy; no CVSS score or CVE is invented. Inconclusive means evidence was insufficient. Stale means the observation may no longer describe the current configuration. Only a later comparable check confirms resolution.
